entities.summary: Gina Barkhordar Nahai is an Iranian-born American author. She is known for the novels Cry of the Peacock (1991), Moonlight on the Avenue of Faith (1999), Sunday's Silence (2001), and Caspian Rain (2007). She was formerly a lecturer in the Master of Professional Writing Program at the University of Southern California.
